topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Finding out that my child has the same teacher I had feels like a strange twist of fate. I remember the classroom, square and sterile, the chalkboard that always seemed too tall. That teacher, so strict, so exacting, the way they stood, the tone of their voice, it still brings back memories I thought I'd left behind. I can't shake the sense that history might repeat itself, and I worry about the afternoons that stretched long with dread, the homework that never seemed manageable. I hope my child will have a different experience, but I can’t help the uneasy thoughts that keep circling back.
